(e) On November 12, 2026, the stockholders of Wave Life Sciences, Inc. (the “Company”) approved an amendment to the Company’s Amended and Restated 2021 Equity Incentive Plan (the “Amended 2021 Equity Incentive Plan”), that increases the total number of shares of common stock authorized for issuance of awards under the Amended 2021 Equity Incentive Plan by 11,000,000 shares. A detailed summary of the material features of the Amended 2021 Equity Incentive Plan is set forth in the Company’s definitive proxy statement for its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the “Annual Meeting”) filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on October 14, 2026 (the “Proxy Statement”). That summary and the foregoing description are qualified in their entirety by reference to the text of the Amended 2021 Equity Incentive Plan, which is filed as Exhibit 10.1 hereto and incorporated herein by reference. Item 5.07 Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders. (a) On November 12, 2026, the Company held its Annual Meeting. Of the 197,228,058 shares of common stock issued and outstanding and eligible to vote as of the record date of October 8, 2026, a quorum of 166,197,073 shares of the Company’s voting capital stock, or 84%, of the eligible shares, was present in person or represented by proxy at the Annual Meeting. (b) The following actions were taken at the Annual Meeting, all of which are described in the Proxy Statement. The final voting results for each of the proposals voted upon at the Annual Meeting are set forth below.
